description: Document one consequential architecture decision.

# Adr

## Inputs

Decision context, drivers, options, constraints, evidence, related feature.

## Process

Read `AGENTS.md`, confirm the active lifecycle state and authority, inspect only relevant canonical artifacts, and make no assumption that is not supported by evidence or an explicit decision.

## Required output

Numbered ADR with options, decision, consequences, validation, rollback, and supersession links.

Include artifact paths, traceability links, risks, evidence, owner, and recommended next lifecycle state.

## Stop conditions

Stop if the decision can be reversed cheaply or lacks an accountable owner.
